channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Boulos e presidentes do BB e Caixa batem boca em reunião com Lula e Alckmin
item.description: At a meeting at the Palácio do Planalto, Minister Guilherme Boulos exchanged criticisms with the presidents of Banco do Brasil and Caixa Econômica Federal in the presence of President Lula and Vice Alckmin. The tension revolved around disagreements on economic policies and bank management.

item.title: Pesquisa Quaest para presidente: veja números da última e quando sai nova
item.description: Quaest released its latest presidential poll on August 14, with a margin of error of ±2 percentage points. Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) lead the first-round vote intentions.

item.title: Advogado diz que se Lulinha não fosse filho do presidente caso teria sido arquivado
item.description: Marco Aurélio Carvalho, lawyer for Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, claimed the inquiries involving the president’s son would have been archived if not for his surname. He criticized the notion that Lulinha is subject to stricter scrutiny due to his family ties and compared the PGR’s stance—seeking to move the cases from the STF to lower courts—to the protection Bolsonaro allegedly gave his relatives. Carvalho emphasized the defense has long argued the investigations should proceed in the first instance.

item.title: Marçal diz esperar que decisão proibindo debates, campanha na TV e acesso a fundos 'seja revista'
item.description: Pablo Marçal (PRTB) expressed concern over the TSE's decision barring him from public funds, TV/radio campaigns, and debates, while hoping for a review. The unanimous ruling, led by Minister Estela Aranha, cited risks of misusing public resources for a legally unviable candidacy. Marçal remains ineligible until 2032 due to a prior conviction for improper media use during campaigns.

item.title: Tarcísio recebe R$ 1 milhão do fundo partidário do Republicanos
item.description: São Paulo governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) reported to the Electoral Court the receipt of R$1 million from the party's electoral fund for his campaign. This donation is among the first formalized contributions by candidates for the state government, including Vera Lúcia (PSTU) and Vivian Mendes (UP).

item.title: Nunes promete a Flávio e a Tarcísio "um exército disposto a lutar"
item.description: Ricardo Nunes, Flávio Bolsonaro and Tarcísio de Freitas met for a political lunch in São Paulo's east side, where Nunes highlighted the support of an 'army' for the campaign. During Flávio's agenda in the region, residents protested against the candidate, criticizing policies like tolls and civilian weapons.

item.title: ‘Factoide infantil’ e ‘sabotagem’, diz vice de Renan Santos sobre filiação de Flávio ao Missão
item.description: Aroldo Medina, running mate of Renan Santos (Missão), labeled the alleged fraudulent affiliation of Flávio Bolsonaro to the party as 'childish hoaxes' and 'sabotage,' a case under investigation by the TSE. Medina also criticized Pablo Marçal's candidacy, stressing support for a serious and transparent election. The incident was seen as an attempt to divert attention from key campaign issues.

item.title: Salles se descreve como liberal na economia, conservador nos costumes e diz que 8 de janeiro 'foi uma baderna'
item.description: Ricardo Salles, running for Senate in São Paulo, described his ideology as economically liberal and socially conservative, citing influences such as Ronald Reagan and Margaret Thatcher. He criticized left-wing candidates and internal divisions within the right, emphasizing state reduction and privatizations.

item.title: Para atender a PGR, STF tem que acabar com inquérito das Fake News
item.description: The STF faces pressure from the PGR to move Lula's son's inquiry to first instance, potentially ending the Fake News inquiry. The article questions the legitimacy of political investigations and suggests the inquiry was used to pressure opponents.

item.title: O gesto de Lula para ampliar ofensiva por avanço de matérias prioritárias no Congresso
item.description: Lula intensifies efforts in Congress alongside leaders such as Hugo Motta and Davi Alcolumbre, aiming to pass priority bills before the elections. Among them is the MP that abolishes the tax on small firearms, expected to be debated in September.

item.title: Entenda por que show de Zezé Di Camargo ocultou o número 13
item.description: Zezé Di Camargo's concert in Rio Verde, Goiás, sparked controversy after the number 13 was replaced with '12+1' in promotional materials. Organizer Alcidon Neto claimed it was a personal decision unrelated to the singer, particularly amid concerns during the electoral period. The number 13 is linked to President Lula (PT), while Zezé publicly supports Jair Bolsonaro (PL).

item.title: Candidatos 60+ representam 38% dos que disputam vagas no Senado
item.description: Candidates aged 60 or older account for 38.4% of the 315 Senate candidacies in 2026, up 2.6 percentage points from 2018. This trend reflects Brazil's aging population, with 17.1% of projected voters in the same age group. The oldest candidate is Marlene Soccas (92) and the oldest male candidate is Carlos Sodré (80), while 21 candidates are between 35 and 39 years old, marking the first Senate election including those born after the 1988 Constitution was promulgated.

item.title: Caso Lulinha: os detalhes do inquérito sigiloso da PF que investiga tráfico de influência no governo
item.description: The Federal Police is investigating President Lula's son, Fábio Luís da Silva (Lulinha), for allegedly acting as a hidden broker for businessmen seeking deals with the federal government. Suspicions arise from messages of lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger, linking a group involved in a corruption and influence trafficking scheme that includes figures like the 'Careca do INSS' and former chief of staff Marcola. The case has been under investigation since the 'Operation Sem Desconto', which dismantled a gang that embezzled R$6 billion from the pension system.

item.title: Saiba quem são os candidatos ao governo e ao Senado em Rondônia
item.description: The 2026 elections in Rondônia feature six gubernatorial candidates and ten senatorial candidates, marked by a diverse range of parties and political trajectories. Gubernatorial contenders include Adailton Fúria (PSD), Expedito Netto (PT), Hildon Chaves (União Brasil), Marcos Rogério (PL), Pedro Abib (MDB), and Samuel Costa (PSB). On the Senate side, names such as Acir Gurgacz (PDT), Bruno Bolsonaro Scheid (PL), and Mariana Carvalho (Republicanos) stand out among the candidates.

item.title: Flávio diz que pretende entrar para a história 'nem que seja como presidente de transição'
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, PL candidate for President of Brazil, stated he aims to go down in history 'even if only as a transition president'. The senator did not elaborate on his strategy but emphasized his commitment to political trajectory and ideological continuity.

item.title: Concentração de pagamentos de emendas no começo do ano muda trajetória fiscal, diz IFI
item.description: The Brazilian government accelerated the payment of parliamentary amendments in the first half of 2026, according to a report by IFI, an institution linked to the Senate. This pattern of fiscal concentration before elections may affect the trajectory of public accounts.

item.title: Flávio diz a empresários de SP que olha com "nojo" para o STF
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated at an event in São Paulo that he looks at the STF with 'revulsion,' criticizing the court's impunity. He promised, if elected, to appoint conservative justices to the STF, opposing abortion and drugs.

item.title: Manoel Gomes marca Tarcísio do Acordeon ao divulgar apoio de Tarcísio
item.description: Singer Manoel Gomez made a gaffe by tagging Governor Tarcísio de Freitas as Tarcísio do Acordeon, an error disclosed in an unverified post. In a video, the governor declared support for Manoel's candidacy for federal deputy for São Paulo by Avante.

item.title: O que significa Dark Horse, termo ligado a Flávio e Jair Bolsonaro
item.description: Dark Horse, a biographical film about Jair Bolsonaro produced in the US starring Jim Caviezel, was commented on by Flávio Bolsonaro during a campaign event. The film depicts Bolsonaro's 2018 election campaign when he was considered a 'dark horse' - an unlikely winner candidate.

item.title: TSE determina retirada de vídeo de IA que liga Flávio Bolsonaro a Daniel Vorcaro
item.description: The Brazilian Electoral Court ordered the removal of an AI-generated video linking Flávio Bolsonaro to banker Daniel Vorcaro, giving 24 hours to comply. Minister André Mendonça ruled the content potentially misleading despite claims of satire, and mandated Meta and Vakinha to provide data to identify the poster.

item.title: Áudio: Candidatos se declaram negros por vantagem eleitoral, afetando ação afirmativa
item.description: Black candidates account for 49.9% of filings for the 2026 elections, but the practice of racial self-declaration is being questioned when used strategically to access affirmative action policies, a phenomenon known as electoral afro-convenience. Senator Paulo Paim (PT-RS) discusses the impacts of this practice on political representation and Brazilian democracy.

item.title: Boulos chama Flávio de “cínico” e cobra explicações sobre R$ 61 milhões
item.description: The Minister-Chief of the General Secretariat of the Presidency, Guilherme Boulos, called Senator Flávio Bolsonaro 'cynical' and demanded explanations regarding R$61 million spent on the documentary 'Dark Horse,' which covers Jair Bolsonaro's trajectory. The debate arose after Flávio claimed he had already provided the necessary accounts for the expenses.

item.title: Crusoé: Mendonça vai abrir mão dos inquéritos sobre Lulinha?
item.description: Supreme Federal Court Minister André Mendonça does not intend to step down from the investigations into businessman Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha, son of President Lula. This stance opposes the guidance of the Attorney's Office, which requested the transfer of the cases. The information was reported by Folha de S.Paulo based on sources close to the minister.

item.title: Caiado ironiza Flávio por demora em prestar contas sobre Dark Horse
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado mocked Flávio Bolsonaro for not having accounted for the film 'Dark Horse', which depicts Jair Bolsonaro. Flávio claimed the case was 'closed', but Caiado questioned the delay in providing accountability.

item.title: Campanha de Lula investe no chapéu ‘pop’ e aposta em apelo emocional para desgastar Flávio na TV
item.description: Lula's campaign adopts the hat as a visual element and uses emotional appeal to attack Flávio Bolsonaro, highlighting the PT legacy and criticizing the Bolsonaro administration. Free electoral ads begin on the 28th, with programs airing on the 29th, where Lula will make comparisons between governments and address issues like the Hunger Map and social proposals. The strategy includes suggesting that Flávio's values oppose those of most Brazilians.

item.title: Quais seleções já estão classificadas para a Copa do Mundo Feminina 2027?
item.description: Teams already qualified for the 2027 Women's World Cup include Brazil (host), Colombia and Argentina from CONMEBOL, plus Spain, France, Denmark and Germany from UEFA. Ecuador and Venezuela compete for spots in the international playoff, while 32 European teams contend for seven direct slots in UEFA's internal playoff.

item.title: Lula tira da vice-liderança do governo deputado que coordena a campanha de Ciro Gomes
item.description: President Lula removed Mauro Benevides Filho from the government's vice-leadership in the Chamber of Deputies because he coordinates Ciro Gomes' campaign, a candidate for Ceará state government and opponent of the PT. Benevides had previously been removed after declaring support for Ciro but was later reinstated. The decision, formalized in the Official Gazette, reflects internal tensions within the PT ahead of the state election in Ceará.

item.title: Em Pernambuco, federação PSDB-Cidadania aciona Justiça para sair da coligação de Raquel Lyra
item.description: The PSDB-Cidadania federation filed a lawsuit with the TRE-PE to withdraw from Raquel Lyra's coalition, prompting a reaction from the governor who seeks to maintain the alliance. The decision by the national intervention, led by Aécio Neves and Alex Manente, annulled the state convention supporting Lyra and adopted neutrality in the elections. Lyra's team accuses the intervention of being irregular and rushed, alleging violation of defense rights.

item.title: Argentino das urnas é denunciado por tentativa de feminicídio
item.description: The Santa Cruz prosecutor's office (Argentina) filed a formal indictment against Fernando Cerimedo, known in Brazil for questioning the voting machines in 2022, for attempted femicide against his partner. Cerimedo serves as an advisor to President Rodrigo Paz and is part of the Argentine government's digital team.

item.title: Crusoé: Lulinha também processa Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Entrepreneur Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha, sued Senator Flávio Bolsonaro over alleged links to the INSS pension fraud scandal. The case involves an AI-generated video, escalating legal clashes between factions tied to the Bolsonaro and Lula legacies.

item.title: O apresentador de TV que é esperança de puxador de votos em São Paulo
item.description: TV host Sikêra Jr., known for conservative and controversial speeches, was nominated for federal deputy in Sao Paulo by Republicanos with the support of Governor Tarcisio de Freitas and the party's president, Marcos Pereira. His candidacy aims to expand the party's caucus, leveraging his media profile and public security discourse. Despite his prominence, Sikêra faces convictions for transphobic and discriminatory speeches against the LGBTQIA+ community.

item.title: Caiado ironiza Flávio após ele dizer que Dark Horse é "página virada"
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado mocked Flávio Bolsonaro for not delivering accounts regarding the film 'Dark Horse', financed with R$61 million from jailed banker Daniel Vorcaro. Flávio claimed the case is 'closed', but Caiado questions the delay and accuracy of the accounts.

item.title: TSE proíbe Pablo Marçal de fazer campanha eleitoral
item.description: The Brazilian Electoral Supreme Court (TSE) banned Pablo Marçal (PRTB) from participating in the presidential campaign through a preliminary injunction supported by the Electoral Public Ministry, which alleges his ineligibility until 2032 due to a prior electoral conviction and party affiliation irregularity. The candidate is barred from participating in debates and using free electoral broadcast time. A final ruling has not yet been scheduled.

item.title: Com Tarcísio, Flávio diz que quer entrar para a história mesmo que como ‘um presidente de transição’
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated, during a campaign event with Tarcísio de Freitas in São Paulo, that he aims to be part of Brazilian history, even as a 'transition president,' praising the governor and reinforcing strategic alliances. Support from mayor Ricardo Nunes seeks to expand influence in the metropolitan region.

item.title: “Você tem potencial de algum dia ser presidente”, diz Flávio a Nikolas
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated in a YouTube video that federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) has potential to become president in the future. The comment was made during a political discussion about Nikolas' trajectory; at 30 years old, he can only run for president in 2034 under current rules. Flávio also expressed uncertainty about the length of the presidential term after his potential mandate.

item.title: A ligação de Pablo Marçal para Flávio Bolsonaro após registrar candidatura
item.description: Ineligible Pablo Marçal (PRTB) spoke with Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) after registering his presidential candidacy on Saturday. The article, exclusive to subscribers, highlights the call hours after the electoral court deadline.

item.title: Vice de Flávio ironiza Motta após Câmara negar escolta na campanha
item.description: Alfredo Gaspar, Flávio Bolsonaro's running mate, mocked Hugo Motta after the Chamber denied legislative police protection during the campaign. Gaspar said he won't ask for favors, respecting the decision as an institutional matter.

item.title: A aposta de vice de Renan Santos para que candidato enfrente Lula no segundo turno
item.description: Aroldo Medina, running mate of Renan Santos (Missão), believes the presidential candidate could reach the runoff against Lula, emphasizing that 70% of voters are unaware of Renan and his growth potential. Recent polls show Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro leading, but Renan fluctuates between 4% and 7.8% in voting intentions.

item.title: Cappelli promete programa para valorizar professores na rede pública
item.description: Ricardo Cappelli (PSB), candidate for Federal District Governor, pledged to offer public school teachers the highest salary in Brazil and criticized the current administration's low IDEB scores. He also proposed integrated health systems, addressing root causes of homelessness, and a broader left-wing alliance, without progress on the vice-governor proposal with Leandro Grass (PT).

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro se defende sobre ‘Dark Horse’: “Página virada”
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, presidential candidate from PL, stated he has already provided the necessary accounting and clarifications regarding expenses for the Dark Horse documentary, which covers Jair Bolsonaro's trajectory. He said 'page turned' when asked about charges from the PT.

item.title: Mendonça determina remoção de vídeo de IA que liga Flávio a Vorcaro
item.description: TSE Minister André Mendonça ordered the removal of an AI-generated video linking Senator Flávio Bolsonaro to the founder of Banco Master, Daniel Vorcaro, citing it as a misleading fabrication. The video, posted on August 14, incorporates visual elements from Flávio's campaign and was described as a musical satire. The decision responds to a request from Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign.

item.title: Lulinha vai à Justiça e pede indenização de Flávio por vídeo com IA
item.description: Fábio Luiz Lula da Silva, son of President Lula, filed a lawsuit against Flávio Bolsonaro over an AI-generated video accusing him of pension fraud. His defense team seeks the removal of the post, R$10,000 in moral damages, and a ban on repeating the false allegations. The lawsuit was filed in São Paulo state court after the video was posted on July 7th across social media platforms.

item.title: Haddad: ‘Tarcísio presta um desserviço a São Paulo ao apoiar Flávio Bolsonaro’
item.description: Haddad criticized Tarcísio for supporting Flávio Bolsonaro, calling him an institutional risk. He advocates federal cooperation against crime and highlights Finance Ministry investments.

item.title: STF arquiva queixa de Weverton Rocha contra Kim Kataguiri
item.description: The STF dismissed Senator Weverton Rocha's criminal complaint against Congressman Kim Kataguiri, ruling that the deputy was protected by parliamentary immunity when commenting on INSS investigations. The unanimous decision stated that the statements were part of legislative debate.

item.title: Casas Bahia, blusinhas e 6×1 levam campanha para a rotina do eleitor
item.description: The 2026 election campaign shifts focus to voters' daily lives, emphasizing supermarket prices and consumption. Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leverages high inflation and Lula's government setbacks, while Lula (PT) counters with favorable economic data. The race now unfolds in settings like stores and social media, with direct price comparisons.

item.title: Ao vivo: Lula anuncia supercomputador de IA, em Macaíba
item.description: President Lula announced the deployment of an AI-dedicated supercomputer during a visit to the Augusto Severo Scientific and Technological Park in Macaíba (RN). The initiative aims to enhance Brazil's technological capabilities, support scientific research, and boost the national economy.

item.title: Caiado defende presença obrigatória em debates e diz que candidatos que não vão 'têm muito a esconder'
item.description: Caiado advocates for mandatory candidate participation in electoral debates, criticizing Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro for not attending the Band debate. He also proposes legislative reform to establish clear rules for debates and discusses the possibility of debates organized by press consortia.

item.title: Tarcísio e a caixa preta da bilhetagem
item.description: The São Paulo state government maintains, without public bidding, a metropolitan transportation ticketing system managed by Abasp, whose 2020 contract with Autopass has drawn scrutiny from the court of auditors and the public prosecutors. The state regulator Artesp recently ruled that passenger balances can no longer fund the operator's costs, yet Tarcísio de Freitas persists in defending the model as a deliberate, recorded decision.

item.title: TSE manda remover vídeo com IA que liga Flávio Bolsonaro a Vorcaro
item.description: TSE minister André Mendonça ordered the removal of an AI-generated video linking Flávio Bolsonaro to Daniel Vorcaro. The content must be taken down from platforms within 24 hours of notification.

item.title: Governo amplia a R$ 200 mil teto de financiamento para motoristas de apps de olho em eleição
item.description: The federal government raised the financing ceiling for app and taxi drivers' vehicles from R$150,000 to R$200,000, now including hybrid and electric cars. The measure aims to reduce costs and modernize the fleet, directly impacting the economy of workers in the sector.
